responsibility: Performs Rust item and body type checking by orchestrating well-formedness and signature validation for items and intrinsics, constructing shared and per-body checking contexts, pre-gathering local declarations, then type-checking expressions, patterns, operators, calls, casts, closures, generators, matches, methods, place operations, and trait/impl relationships using expectation propagation, autoderef, coercion, demand constraints, divergence tracking, and deferred checks. It also analyzes upvar capture and generator interiors, enforces drop and region requirements, applies inference fallback, produces body-oriented diagnostics and suggestions, and finally writes resolved per-body type information back into permanent type-check results.
